name: Russia–NATO
summary: Drone ship sinkings off Bulgaria and airspace violations on NATO's flank
state: Ukraine says Russian drones sank four cargo ships just outside Bulgarian waters in October, and Romania blamed Russia for a ship sunk by drone (23 Oct). Russian jets have entered Polish, Lithuanian and Estonian airspace, and EU intelligence agencies warn of sabotage plots against defence firms (Al Jazeera, 29 Oct). No Article 4 request as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Direct conflict is not under way, but incidents are rising. Follow official advice if travelling near NATO's eastern borders.
rubric_hit: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Russia's alleged sabotage campaign in Europe raises fears of escalation
CEPA — Russian strikes rise across NATO's eastern flank

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
drivers: Airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, Baltic incidents, nuclear signalling, Ukraine war spillover.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
